metadata.window_title: UI Smoke - SPV UI Surface Probe

text.String: Shader canvas is now a first-class native UI lane.
This smoke packages a real font asset, emits SPIR-V, builds a native executable, and samples the packed MSDF atlas inside the fragment shader.
Host: native window, shader bundle, realtime bundle, packed font asset sidecar, canvas surface presentation.
Client: Kain fragment shader, atlas texture sampling, procedural panel composition, SPIR-V-canonical shader artifact output.
MSDF atlas sampled live from packaged font assets
A canvas node now survives all the way into the native runtime as a shader-canvas surface, not a viewport placeholder.
Relative font assets resolve from the source root, get packaged beside the executable, and feed the native MSDF atlas cache.
The shader preview is not faking the lane with CPU text drawing: it samples the runtime-provided atlas texture inside the fragment shader.
